name: Egalin's Grimoire
summary: In the Undercity, Egalin's Grimoire guides warlocks who seek to summon and command a voidwalker. A master warlock wrote it to teach at the Temple of the Damned.

sections.title: A Master's Work
sections.body: Egalin's Grimoire gives the means to call a being of chaos from the Nether. Egalin was a master summoner, famed for commanding voidwalkers with ease. He taught his skill to his students, among them Carendin Halgar. Without the book's formulas and methods of channeling, an unprepared summoner may be torn apart by the being called forth.

sections.title: The Scarlet Theft
sections.body: Perrine, an operative of the Scarlet Crusade, stole Egalin's Grimoire from the Forsaken warlocks and hid it in a chest in a tower in western Tirisfal Glades. The Crusade hated dark magic, yet Perrine seemed to know little of the book's true significance. The tome was treated as seized heretical salvage until Forsaken initiates seeking to master the void retrieved it.

faq.answer: Egalin was a talented warlock who mentored Carendin Halgar. He was the first among them to summon a voidwalker and commanded chaotic entities with ease.

faq.q: Why is Egalin's Grimoire so dangerous?
faq.answer: Egalin's Grimoire contains the incantations and methods of channeling needed to summon a voidwalker. A warlock who attempts the rite without mastering these instructions risks being torn apart by the summoned void entity.

faq.q: How did the Scarlet Crusade get the book?
faq.answer: Perrine, an agent of the Scarlet Crusade, stole Egalin's Grimoire from the Forsaken warlocks. Perrine hid it in a chest at a Crusade watchtower in western Tirisfal Glades and seemed unaware of its true magical worth.
Carendin Halgar, the warlock trainer in the Temple of the Damned beneath the Undercity, needs the grimoire to teach new initiates to summon and bind voidwalkers.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can learn from Egalin's Grimoire how to summon a voidwalker from the Nether and bind it to your will. This rite marks a passage for practitioners.
As an undead, you help keep a powerful magical artifact from the Undercity's practitioners out of the Scarlet Crusade's hands when you recover the book.
